what: Run 1 treated '@' as a 1995 format flag and rejected records such as n67_rct4.few with reason "legacy @ record not in this decoder".
where_the_hash_is_stored: These SHA-256 values are the code_sha256 object inside summary.json. They were written at the end of that process, while decode_flam.py still contained the '@' format-flag check. They are not the hashes of the files after that check was removed.
do_not_backfill: Do not replace summary.json code_sha256 or public_failure.json with a later source hash.
